acts.name: The Return
acts.theme: The man who left and the man who stayed quiet

acts.name: The Name
acts.theme: Familiarity is not the same as innocence

acts.name: What He Carries
acts.theme: Love that does not spend the past as coin

acts.name: Three Days
acts.theme: What breaks when the quiet man is the one bleeding

acts.name: The Last Question
acts.theme: They choose each other and still refuse the Bell

volumes.title: The Return
volumes.purpose: Calder takes the ORCHID detail; Ivo knows him and stays silent; the expedition enters the Orrocanopy and reaches the first stones of Qalen-Sar.

volumes.title: The Name
volumes.purpose: Ruins, creatures, and Calder's unrecognized memories build to the gallery collapse, where he finally says Ivo's name.

volumes.title: What He Carries
volumes.purpose: Apology without excuse, Ivo's precise revenge, Calder falls in love, confesses, and is rejected. The warmth is put away.

volumes.title: Three Days
volumes.purpose: Distance, the Unfinished, the collapse, Calder's injury, Ivo's break, the confession, and the proof Calder heard it.

volumes.title: The Last Question
volumes.purpose: Partners finish the expedition, refuse the Bell, pay the cost, and live with a hum that has not finished changing.
